title: console matrix report: a date column axis renders in first-seen row order, not by bucket key, whenever the empty-bucket fill does not run (and a report order that fixes it loses the select axis's option order)
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Priority p2. Found by a hosted walkthrough of HotCRM 6.4 (hotcrm#2526) and measured on a dev server with HotCRM main 3617fbd and @objectstack 18.5.0.

**The report.** `cases_opened_by_day_priority` is a matrix with rows `priority` (a select), columns `created_at` (a date dimension, `dateGranularity: 'day'`) and values `case_count`. Neither the report nor the dataset declares an order.

**What happens.** Whenever the empty date-bucket fill (#26893, service-analytics 18.3.0) does not run, the day columns come out in **first-seen row order**. You get one ascending run per priority, laid end to end. The hosted tenant shows 31 columns with 10-06 in 18th place.

Measured on the dev server with the fill switched off by a measure order (`order [{by: case_count, desc}]`):

```
11-12 11-16 11-14 10-18 10-27 11-03 11-06 11-09 11-11 11-13 10-22 10-25 10-28 10-31 10-23 11-05 11-08 11-04 Total
```

By the analytics CHANGELOG, the fill does not run for:
- a selection with limit/offset;
- an order on a measure;
- `compareTo`;
- a grid over 2,000 cells.

In those cases the renderer has nothing to restore the order.

**Why an app cannot fix it.** A report `order [{by: created_at, asc}]` makes the columns ascend, with or without the fill. But once the report carries any `order`, the renderer follows the query row order on **both** axes. A query order on a select sorts by stored value. So the rows go from the option order Low / Medium / High / Critical to Critical / High / Low / Medium. Ordering by both the date and the select gives the same result. The app trades one wrong order for another.

**Ask.**
1. The matrix renderer sorts a date or datetime column axis (and row axis) by bucket key, whatever the query order or row arrival order.
2. It keeps a select axis in option order, as it does today when there is no `order`, even when the report carries an `order` for the other axis.

**Not readable from here.** The hosted walk shows days missing (11-05 to 11-15 absent) and runs grouped by priority. On 18.3+ the fill would have listed every day, so the hosted runtime does not seem to serve 18.3+ dataset answers for this query. Which analytics version hosted runs is unknown here, because the cloud repository answers 403. A cloud seat should confirm it.

**Also exposed:** `lead_inflow_by_month_source` (columns `last_contacted_date` by month), and any matrix over a date dimension.

Readings: the hotcrm project file `hosted-6-4-walk/matrix-order-2526-probe.txt`, with a screenshot of the fill-off grid. hotcrm#2526 waits on this card.

Re-check: on 18.5.0, open the report with a measure order and read the column header order.
